description_en: Queries the system default path rules, or the user profile roaming rules for a specified app instance group or app instance group set
description_zh: 查询系统默认路径规则，或查询指定交付组及交付组集合的用户数据漫游规则
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center describe-user-profile-path-rules --rule-type AppInstanceGroup --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeUserProfilePathRules

parameters.help_en: The app instance group ID. Specify either this parameter or AppInstanceGroupSetId when querying app instance group rules. This parameter can be omitted when querying system default rules
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID。查询交付组规则时与 AppInstanceGroupSetId 二选一。查询系统默认规则时可省略
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The app instance group set ID. Specify either this parameter or AppInstanceGroupId when querying app instance group set rules. This parameter can be omitted when querying system default rules
parameters.help_zh: 交付组集合 ID。查询集合规则时与 AppInstanceGroupId 二选一。查询系统默认规则时可省略
parameters.name: app_instance_group_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The path rule type. Valid values:
`Default`: Queries system default rules. Both target IDs can be omitted.
`AppInstanceGroup`: Queries the rules of an app instance group or an app instance group set
parameters.help_zh:
路径规则类型。
`Default`：查询系统默认规则，可省略两个目标 ID。
`AppInstanceGroup`：查询交付组或交付组集合的规则
parameters.name: rule_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the request. When querying or setting rules for a specified app instance group, use the region where the target app instance group is located
parameters.help_zh: 请求地域 ID。查询或设置指定交付组的规则时，使用目标交付组所在地域
parameters.name: region_id

schema.description_en: The response to the API call
schema.description_zh: 本次 API 调用的响应结果

Code.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails
Code.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误码

Data.description_en: The path rules and user profile roaming configurations
Data.description_zh: 路径规则和用户数据漫游配置

AppInstanceGroupId.description_en: The app instance group ID corresponding to the rule. When querying set rules, this is the primary app instance group ID
AppInstanceGroupId.description_zh: 规则对应的交付组 ID。查询集合规则时为主交付组 ID

AppInstanceGroupSetId.description_en: The app instance group set ID corresponding to the rule. This is returned when querying set rules
AppInstanceGroupSetId.description_zh: 规则对应的交付组集合 ID，查询集合规则时返回

DomainId.description_en: The user profile roaming storage domain ID bound to the app instance group. This field may be omitted if no domain is bound
DomainId.description_zh: 交付组绑定的用户数据漫游存储域 ID。未绑定时可能省略

FileSystemId.description_en: Not enabled. The current query result does not provide the file system ID. The example is used to illustrate the field status
FileSystemId.description_zh: 尚未启用，当前查询结果不提供文件系统 ID。示例用于说明字段状态

ProfileFollowSwitch.description_en: The user profile roaming switch. A value of `true` indicates that the feature is enabled, and a value of `false` indicates that the feature is disabled
ProfileFollowSwitch.description_zh: 用户数据漫游开关。`true` 表示已开启，`false` 表示已关闭

RemoteStoragePath.description_en: The remote storage path for user profile roaming. If this path is not separately configured for the app instance group, the app instance group ID is returned
RemoteStoragePath.description_zh: 用户数据漫游的远程存储路径。交付组未单独配置该路径时返回交付组 ID

RuleType.description_en:
The path rule type. Valid values:
`Default`: Queries system default rules. Both target IDs can be omitted.
`AppInstanceGroup`: Queries the rules of an app instance group or an app instance group set
RuleType.description_zh:
路径规则类型。
`Default`：查询系统默认规则，可省略两个目标 ID。
`AppInstanceGroup`：查询交付组或交付组集合的规则

Rules.description_en: The list of user profile roaming path rules
Rules.description_zh: 用户数据漫游路径规则列表

items.description_en: A single rule, including the excluded paths and the exception paths within the excluded directories
items.description_zh: 单条规则，包括排除路径和被排除目录中的例外路径

BlackPath.description_en: The file or directory excluded from user profile roaming
BlackPath.description_zh: 从用户数据漫游中排除的文件或目录

Path.description_en: The excluded path relative to the user profile directory
Path.description_zh: 相对于用户配置目录的排除路径

Type.description_en:
The path type. Valid values:
`file`: File.
`folder`: Folder

WhitePaths.description_en: The list of files or directories that still participate in user profile roaming under the excluded directories
WhitePaths.description_zh: 排除目录下仍参与用户数据漫游的文件或目录列表

items.description_en: A roaming exception rule within an excluded directory
items.description_zh: 被排除目录中的一条漫游例外规则

Path.description_en: The exception path relative to BlackPath.Path
Path.description_zh: 相对于 BlackPath.Path 的例外路径

Type.description_en:
The path type. Valid values:
`file`: File.
`folder`: Folder

UserProfileSize.description_en: The storage quota for user profile roaming, in GB. This field may be omitted if it is not configured
UserProfileSize.description_zh: 用户数据漫游的空间配额，单位为 GB。未配置时可能省略

UserProfileSwitch.description_en: The user profile roaming switch. The value is the same as ProfileFollowSwitch. A value of `true` indicates that the feature is enabled, and a value of `false` indicates that the feature is disabled
UserProfileSwitch.description_zh: 用户数据漫游开关，值与 ProfileFollowSwitch 一致。`true` 表示已开启，`false` 表示已关闭

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the request fails
Message.description_zh: 请求失败时返回的错误说明

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，可用于排查问题
